notes.title: Becoming Free
notes.notes:
Fake World will soon be making the shift to become free. The game hasn't been getting much traction, the hope is going free will get it into more players' hands. I highly encourage anyone who paid for the game recently to request a refund through Steam. I would love for everyone to be able to do this, but Steam has a two week rule.

If you have any issues there are three ways to contact me: through Steam, DM me on Twitter @PeoplePersonPro or email me at PeoplePersonProductions@gmail.com
